entries.subject: gate0-multi-height
entries.title: Short and tall fighters hit each other
entries.passMark: 1.15 m, 1.80 m and 2.45 m fighters pass validate_char.py; light_1 connects on frame 7 both ways and whiffs without pitch aiming; the throw pins within 0.02 m; and the browser arena's 600-tick p95 frame time, render included, stays under 16.6 ms
entries.summary: A 1.15 m and a 2.45 m fighter hit each other both ways and throws line up; the frame-time check in a browser has not been run yet.

measured.label: Jab on frame 7, both directions
measured.value: Connects with pitch aiming, whiffs without it

measured.label: Throw pin
measured.value: Under 0.02 m error, victim kept above the floor

measured.label: 600-tick step time, headless
measured.value: p50 0.0286 ms, p95 0.0912 ms (budget 16.6 ms); no render in the timing

measured.label: Browser frame time with render
measured.value: Not measured; main has no rendered arena

entries.subject: m1-m2-arena-runtime
entries.title: The arena and drop-in fighter loader
entries.passMark: A 3D stage with lock-on and broadcast cameras runs on the 60 Hz fixed-step loop, and the character select screen lists fighters found by the /api/chars scanner
entries.summary: The 60 Hz game clock, camera maths and fighter loader work and are tested; there is no 3D stage or select screen to play on yet.

measured.label: Determinism
measured.value: Identical state hashes across repeated seeded runs

measured.label: /api/chars middleware
measured.value: Rejects bad names, symlinks and oversize or wrong-type writes; writes atomically

measured.label: Browser build
measured.value: 0.67 kB of script; nothing is drawn

entries.subject: m3-combat
entries.title: The full set of combat moves
entries.passMark: Projectiles, teleports, super armor, command throws, launchers, air combos, homing dashes and wall bounces each work in a tested exchange
entries.summary: Trades, armor, guard crush, teleports and the juggle cap are tested; projectiles, launchers, dashes and wall bounces are not.

measured.label: Tested
measured.value: Strike trades, throw clashes, super armor, guard crush, corner teleport, 8-hit juggle cap

measured.label: In code, no test
measured.value: Projectiles, launchers, homing dashes, wall bounces

entries.subject: m4-fighter-factory
entries.title: The Fighter Factory editor and asset tool
entries.passMark: In the running game, Tab or F2 opens a frame scrubber with hitbox, hurtbox, pitch-line and AI-range wireframes; edits save atomically to chars/<id>/; and meshy_adapter.py is safe to rerun
entries.summary: Frame stepping, safe saves to disk and a rerunnable asset tool are tested; the in-game editor with 3D wireframes is not built.

measured.label: Frame stepping while paused
measured.value: Timeline segments and single-frame steps pass

measured.label: meshy_adapter.py
measured.value: Exits 2 with no requests on a bad spec; resumes pending and finished tasks

entries.subject: m5-roster-watch-mode

entries.passMark: All 6 fighters pass validate_char.py --all; all 15 CPU-vs-CPU pairings engage within 300 ticks and pass the ring-occupancy test; and seeded matches finish without stalemates
entries.summary: All six fighters pass validation and every CPU pairing engages in time; full matches to a finish are not tested yet.
